g.text: A · Floating winding — no CT-to-ground connection

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'system-ui', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: The two leads swing ±3.15 V around an undefined midpoint that drifts. Capacitive coupling into the signal path → 60 Hz hum.

g.text: Midpoint is anchored at 0 V. Lead 1 = +3.15 V when lead 2 = −3.15 V (and vice versa). Induced voltages into nearby signal wiring cancel.
